title: carex subulata
intro: Carex subulata, commonly known as the needle sedge or needle grass, is a type of perennial plant native to North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex subulata include its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing and protecting the mucous membranes, and as a diuretic, helping to relieve urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Carex subulata include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
